opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Cal. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 470 U. S. 1083.] Motion of appellees Toward Utility Rate Normalization et al. for divided argument denied.

Justice Blackmun and Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
